# Index of the v3 macros (generated by paper/make_figures.py)

11056 new macros. Group = section of docs/V3_PLAN.md. Value = as in numbers.tex. '[recomputed]' = not printed by a scorer: label exploratory or post hoc in the paper.

Stage 8 (preregistration J; 4136 of the macros) has groups by part instead: S8A = part A (natural passages), S8B = part B (fresh samples, the emitted-form score), S8D = part D (the flag), S8X = counts across parts A, B and D (part C is still running and has no macros yet). Names: J + part (Ja, Jb, Jd, Jx) + statistic + format or arm + model tag; ...Lo and ...Hi are the interval bounds (95 %; the N4 verdict bounds of part B are 98.75 %, as each description says). Negative values are in math mode. '[arithmetic on printed values]' = a count or sum of printed values; a name ending in Min or Max selects a printed string. A value of -0.000 (or -0.0) is the scorer's printed string, kept verbatim; it is marked NEGATIVE ZERO below: in running text quote its interval or range instead.

Generated with MACRO_INDEX_GROUPS=S8A,S8B,S8D,S8X: groups S8A, S8B, S8D, S8X are listed in full; the others are only counted (unset MACRO_INDEX_GROUPS to list every group).
